verdict.rationale: Steel's official GitHub repo says it uses Puppeteer and CDP to control Chrome instances, so you can connect with Puppeteer, Playwright, or Selenium. That directly covers bringing existing automation code to Steel's browsers. The support rests on a single repo statement, without detailed connection docs or hands-on confirmation. missing for 10: first-party docs detailing the connection endpoint/URL flow for Playwright/Puppeteer/raw CDP, independent or hands-on corroboration that existing scripts work unmodified
